'''Mardroot''' is an [[herb]], the oil of which is used in healing wounds. Aside from the name, nothing is known about it. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] uses mardroot oil to help in healing [[Uno Nomesta]]'s wounds sustained during the escape from [[Samara]].{{ref/book|5|49}}
